subject: Marketplaces: SKU mapping, region gating, and cross-cloud fallback plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplaces: initial SKU/region/fallback draft

Hi team —

I've sketched a first-pass approach for how we list on AWS/Azure/GCP and where we should gate or mirror SKUs. High level: keep a single "Core" SKU per cloud for GA (SaaS listing + co-sell), a lighter "Edge" SKU for region-limited/price-sensitive clouds, and explicit "Fallback" variants (quantized/4-bit) to serve as low-cost fallbacks when Dedicated capacity is constrained.

Open questions:
- Should the Core SKU be identical across clouds (same price + metering) or cloud-specific pricing?
- Which regions do we initially enable per cloud to support co-sell (US west/east + EU-West), and do we exclude APAC for GA?
- Legal asks: marketplace contracts require certain indemnities — see attached PRICING matrix for suggested list.

Attachment: marketplace_pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (pricing bands + suggested meters)

Please review and call out major blockers by EOD Friday. I want to align before we loop in partners at the end of next week.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Cloud GTM, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplaces: initial SKU/region/fallback draft

Marissa —

Solid start. A few practical notes from co-sell ops:
- AWS co-sell wants a single SKU per product family to qualify for streamlined listing; we can use SKU-level metadata to surface "Edge" as an add-on, but avoid too many SKUs initially.
- For Azure, customers expect region parity more quickly — customers on Azure in EU are sensitive to data residency. If we delay EU for Azure, Ops will get a lot of inbound support tickets.
- For GCP, pricing flexibility is common; suggest we allow cloud-specific price overrides but keep a published "list price" to keep sales messaging consistent.

I agree with the fallback variants but recommend we treat them as separate model variants (different model-version tag) rather than separate SKUs — reduces marketplace churn and simplifies procurement.

Action: I'll draft a short section on co-sell SKU constraints for the partner packet.

-Ben

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS CoSell Team <aws-cosell@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplaces: initial SKU/region/fallback draft

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the forward. A few notes from a buyer/procurement perspective at Acme Analytics:
- We prefer single-tenant pricing for production (committed) and a metered offering for POC. If you list a Core SKU that supports both, please make sure the billing/metering is clear in the listing (metered vs. subscription).
- For us, region availability is critical. If you list only US/EU and our Azure workloads are in APAC, procurement will delay signing.
- Fallback models with reduced accuracy are fine for cost control, but they must be labeled clearly in the UI and in the contract (we need to avoid FUD during vendor selection).

Happy to be on a quick call with Ben to run through co-sell mechanics and what buyers see in the marketplace UI.

Best,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Cloud Platform, Acme Analytics

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmeanalytics.com>, AWS CoSell Team <aws-cosell@amazon.com>, GCP Partnerships <gcp-partners@google.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplaces: initial SKU/region/fallback draft

Team + partners —

Thanks for the quick feedback. I've consolidated into a proposal (see notes below) and attached the legal redlines we will need to surface to Marketplace legal: "legal_mpo_clause_redlines.docx". High-level proposal:

1) SKU strategy
   - Core SKU (one per cloud): GA listing, co-sell enabled, subscription or metered billing. Unified list price; allow cloud-specific promotions.
   - Edge SKU (optional add-on): region-limited, lower price point, limited throughput. We'll surface as an add-on/plan rather than a new top-level SKU where the marketplace supports it.
   - Fallback variant: model-version tag only; not a separate SKU. Fallbacks are used automatically via smart routing when Dedicated pool is saturated.

2) Region gating and rollout
   - Phase 1 (GA): US-East, US-West, EU-West for all three clouds.
   - Phase 2 (30–60 days after GA): APAC (Singapore/Tokyo) if supported by partner co-sell teams; prioritization will be customer-driven.

3) Pricing mechanics
   - Publish a list price for each cloud's Core SKU. Allow customer-specific pricing via marketplace offers or SSO-linked contract.
   - Metering: token-based metering for hosted; subscription for Dedicated. Documentation must call out difference clearly.

4) Legal & procurement
   - We will surface a separate addendum for Fallback accuracy and SLAs. Marketplace legal needs to review indemnity language in section 4 (see attached redlines).

Open decisions for the group:
- Finalize GA region list (confirm EU-West inclusion for Azure)
- Confirm whether we treat Edge as plan vs. SKU per cloud (Ben prefers plan)
- Agree naming conventions for fallback model-versions to avoid confusing buyers (suggest: "Core", "Core-Lite" as internal names; external listing shows "Standard" / "Low-cost" labels)

Next steps: I propose a 30-minute alignment sync with AWS/GCP reps on Monday 8/9 to confirm co-sell requirements and then a partner-facing brief the following Thursday. I've added the HubSpot deal link in related_links.

-Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmeanalytics.com>, AWS CoSell Team <aws-cosell@amazon.com>, GCP Partnerships <gcp-partners@google.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplaces: initial SKU/region/fallback draft

Thanks everyone — good alignment. Quick decisions and owners: 

- GA regions: APPROVED = US-East, US-West, EU-West. APAC remains Phase 2 (Owner: Laura Bennett to run APAC readiness checklist).
- SKU vs Plan: APPROVED = Core SKU per cloud + Edge as plan/add-on where marketplace supports it (Owner: Ben Carter to document for AWS/Azure/GCP).
- Fallbacks: APPROVED as model-version-only (no public separate SKU). Ops + Runtime team must provide an accuracy delta doc for legal (Owner: Karthik Iyer).
- Pricing: publish unified list price; allow cloud overrides for promotions (Owner: Marissa to finalize list price table this week).

Immediate asks: Ben, can you produce a short spec for how AWS expects add-ons to be represented in the listing (deadline: Fri 8/13)? Karthik, please pull the runtime accuracy/latency deltas and put in Drive by EOD Friday so legal can finish the redlines. Laura, prepare the APAC gating checklist (in Drive folder).

I'll schedule the partner sync for Monday 8/16 and share the brief. Thanks to Sanjay for buyer feedback — we'll incorporate labeling best practices into the listing UI copy.

Marissa
